# https://simplr.co.za

- Primary routes: /work, /about, /services, /thinking, /contact, /est-2014
- Dynamic editorial routes: /work/:slug and /thinking/:topic/:slug
- Root-level landing pages: /:slug
- Content source: WordPress via WPGraphQL
- SEO/GEO assets: structured data, canonical URLs, sitemap.xml, robots.txt, llms-full.txt
